steps.name: Lava
steps.text: What are... these things? Infected creatures?

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: Haven't noticed any signs of infection, though... and you say creatures, but whenever I shoot them, they just turn into black stains and disappear.

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Some kind of Arts?

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: Could be.

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: This can't go on. There's too many of them... we need to find the source.

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Which direction did they enter the village from?

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: Horizon's getting darker, Lava.

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: I know.

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: Still gonna chase 'em?

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: We're still not sure how we even got here... things are a little weird. I'm not a fan of getting in too deep right now.

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: Even if it's a lead, we don't need to rush that hard.

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: B-Benefactors!

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Uh, why'd you come with?

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: What nonsense! How could I abandon my benefactors and flee alone?

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Do you know what those things are?

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: I—I've never seen them before either... Look at how my legs are trembling...

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: They're not some kind of... Yan specialty, right?

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: As if they could be! If this gallery of oddities were crawling all the lands, they would've long since broken national news!

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Kroos, Mr. Nothing, listen to me.

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: I 'can't remember at all' what happened after I pushed open that wooden cottage door. When I came back to my senses, I was already in that garden listening to the...

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: Umbrella-Boiling Hermit.

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Right, listening to the Umbrella-Boiling Hermit tell stories. I have absolutely no impression of how I came to be here. Also, I don't know where 'here' is either.

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: We're all the same.

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: Benefactor, there's one thing I know for certain. This isn't Ni-weng Village...

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: Though I haven't visited Ni-weng in a few years, the way of the land is fashioned quite old. I ran all the way here just now, and I saw not a single electric cable!

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: That makes things even tougher...

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: It's just like we're dreaming, eh.

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: I know what you're thinking, but right now, we've got no other way. We can only trust each other.

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: Ho? Benefactors! You shouldn't doubt me now! I'm not the sort of lout that flouts others' graces to him! I'd hardly even be able!

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: That's not what I meant...

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: I'm just taking in the situation. Everything's been too strange.

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: We're not saying we don't trust you, Nothing, mate, it's just we need to be cool and think about all the possibilities here.

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: Baseline is it's some kind of trap. Whether everything in front of us is real or not.. is a tough question.

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: Now, benefactor, don't treat me like I'm young. I may be carefree as the wind, but I'd still wager I'm older than you...

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Originium Arts... the possibility's there. But the difficulty's beyond. Is it connected to some specific place? Or did they conjure an outright illusion for us...

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: You're quite the eccentrics, my benefactors. Any normal person would never be capable of this line of thought under these pressing circumstances.

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: 'Any normal person,' yeah.

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Even if we don't know where we are, the geography here is way off.

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: The sun and moon are fixed in opposite places, most of the houses are built towards the night side here, while the farms and market are on the other end... but the locals seem totally used to it, and just now, those things...

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: We need information. The faster, the better.

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: The bells are ringing again...?

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: You only hear bells that sound like this in Yan and Higashi.

steps.name: Rough Villager
steps.text: The bells! The bells! Everyone, it's alright! We're safe now!

steps.name: Vigilant Villager
steps.text: So soon?

steps.name: Rough Villager
steps.text: I didn't notice a hint of those things! I saw those outsiders pushing back those monsters for us!

steps.name: Vigilant Villager
steps.text: They're not even scared of the things?

steps.name: Rough Villager
steps.text: As I see it, we should do this in one go! Charge in the mountains and wipe them at the root! I've had it with how they just come whenever they want!

steps.name: Storyteller
steps.text: Don't be like that. You can't be too difficult.

steps.name: Rough Villager
steps.text: Oh, sir... you're back!

steps.name: Storyteller
steps.text: I-Ch'uan, go now and find those three heroes, and tell them I insist they come to my place for a chat. Lest we neglect them, we must properly convey our thanks.

steps.name: Rough Villager
steps.text: Got it!
Hark, I am most at home when I work this bell! If the old head priest of my monastery knew I were still so diligent in foreign lands, he would surely be comforted severalfold.
Saga!

steps.name: Saga
steps.text: Oh, the Shopkeeper! What is the matter?

steps.name: Shopkeeper
steps.text: I heard the bell; that means it's all over, right?

steps.name: Shopkeeper
steps.text: I heard from Mister I-Ch'uan that some guests from afar helped defend the village. Have you seen them?

steps.name: Saga
steps.text: Nay, I have been posted at the bell all this time, have I not? Yet if I had a belltower like unto the one in my monastery, mayhaps I could have seen them from afar.

steps.name: Saga
steps.text: To speak of which, I have been here for some time now. This is the first time I have seen the Ink Spirits come in such great waves. Is it mere happenstance?

steps.name: Shopkeeper
steps.text: That's why I wanted to ask if you could go meet those strangers.

steps.name: Saga
steps.text: Oh?
